camera.note: world: X right, Y up, Z along optical-axis ground projection; camera at (0,h,0)

method_notes: Fused 3 tracker outputs (frame-diff/Hough/optical-flow; median-gated, conf-weighted) over post-contact frames 72-111; duplicated screen-recording frames (87,91,101) merged with midpoint timing. All pixels mapped to the f71 camera frame via per-frame similarity stabilization (LK+RANSAC on background; pan up to ~80 px, zoom negligible: scale 0.996-1.000). Model: p(t)=p0+v0 t+0.5 a t^2 with a=(ax_Magnus, -g, az_drag); az bounded <=0 (fit chose ~0); constant lateral ax=-5.1 m/s^2 was REQUIRED by the data (S-shaped 65-px horizontal residual without it; RMS 41.5->12.9 px) - the ball visibly curls left. p0 anchored on ground (y=0.11 m) at the pre-contact ball pixel; camera pitch + pre-contact depth z0 fitted jointly (h derived from ground constraint); robust Huber loss, conf weights. HONEST UNCERTAINTY: the two metric rulers disagree by ~30%: gravity+timing wants z0~2.4 m (24.6 km/h, rms 12.0) while the measured pre-contact ball radius (41.7 px, D=0.22 m) implies z0=3.41 m (radius-locked fit: 42.8 km/h, rms 16.9). The ratio is fx-independent; plausible causes: mild slow-motion retiming of the source clip (~1.2x would reconcile), smaller-than-assumed ball, or radius overestimation. Reported value = balanced fit (both cues); band [24.6, 43.2] km/h spans gravity-only, radius-locked, intrinsics +/-15% and tilt +/-5 deg scenarios (grid results in fit output). PLAUSIBILITY: this is NOT a full-length free kick - launch is ~3.4 m from the camera and the goal mouth is reached ~6 m downrange at f111 (apex ~0.9-1.7 m): a short lofted curler into a close goal. 30+/-10 km/h is physically consistent with that geometry (a 9.4 m/s, 25 deg launch carries ~7 m); the 60-110 km/h amateur free-kick range does not apply to this short chip. Timing: 52.642 fps screen recording assumed real-time; if the source clip is slow-mo retimed, true speed scales up accordingly (toward the upper half of the band).
